items.content_html:
A (hopefully calmer) redo of #383645

In this implementation, a configuration file is passed to Ghostty directly as opposed to settings being converted to full CLI arguments. The main advantages of this are

  1. generated configurations are easier to digest
  2. shell quoting issues are avoided
  3. options from the user (default) configuration file are still respected

As a bonus, the configuration file format is now available in passthru for use in both this new module and home-manager

  • Enables SSL/TLS

items.content_html:
#375168
databaseActuallyCreateLocally controls the discourse-postgresql.service when true but when false discourse.service still depends on it when it doesn't exist.

This change makes it so you can use these options:
services.discourse.createLocally = false;
services.discourse.database.host = null;
(not create the database with this module and also still use the socket connection)

By extension this allows you to use the discourse module without adding ensureClauses to the postgresql module.
